checks.rationale: tools/list requires OAuth and the vendor publishes no public machine-readable inventory. Review the union of Scalekit's 14 read-only tools and Claude's 16 directory tools. Both official help articles describe read-only access while Wispr's Claude listing advertises task creation and updates; retain write and destructive verdicts for add_task and update_task if they appear. No credentials, authenticated catalog or operational tool calls were used.

evidence.notes: Credential-free curl verified a 401 Bearer resource_metadata challenge with openid offline_access, the exact protected resource, header-only bearer support, dynamic registration, CIMD and PKCE S256. Prefer Google, Apple, Microsoft or enterprise SSO; email-and-password sign-in may not complete authorization because Wispr's help pages disagree. Claude's listing names 16 tools, omitting get_meeting_participants_enriched and resolve_share_link that Scalekit lists. Exposure varies by client/version; the 18 reviewed names are their union, not a claim that every account exposes all names. The plugin at commit 894bbf0e1fa36fc982bf40cf0a0d0bdb7ee3bd62, dated 2026-09-24, provides .mcp.json, README.md, marketplace metadata and assets, with no tool list; Cursor's listing points to the plugin without a tool list. No schema digests are asserted without reviewed schemas.
